proposals.evidence: CDIAL 3208 kukkuṭa explicitly gives Oriya kukuṛā, Gujarati kukṛɔ/kukṛī and Hindi kukṛā/kukṛī cock/hen. The survey chicken forms match those masculine/feminine continuations of the expressive family. Exact survey form kukuḍa is preserved; uncertain intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open.
